topics.title: Numbers to 6 digits: Apply place value to partition, regroup and rename numbers up to 6 digits; expanded notation

questions.stem: How do you write "fifty-nine" as a numeral?
questions.hint: Break the words into place-value parts (ten thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens, ones) and place 0 in any empty column.

keyPoints.note: Match each word group to its place-value column.
Use digits in order from largest place value to ones, keeping zeros as placeholders.

steps.explain: Read the number words "fifty-nine" carefully and identify the largest place-value group.

questions.stem: How should the number \(25\) be placed into the place-value table?
questions.hint: Start from the rightmost digit in the Ones column and work left: Ones, Tens, Hundreds, Thousands, Ten thousands.

keyPoints.note: Align the rightmost digit with the Ones column first.

steps.explain: Start from the rightmost digit of \(25\). The last digit is \(5\), which goes in the Ones column.

questions.stem: Which list orders the numbers 47, 63, 98, 25, 72 from smallest to largest?
questions.hint: Compare the digits from left to right (tens) to place the smallest number first.

keyPoints.note: Start with the least value on the left and end with the greatest value on the right.
Compare the tens digits carefully.

steps.explain: Compare the digits from left to right (tens) to find the smallest number in the set.

questions.stem: Which list shows all the odd numbers between \(5410\) and \(5420\)?
questions.hint: Odd numbers end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9. Start at 5411 and count by +2 up to 5419.

keyPoints.note: Odd numbers end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9.

steps.explain: Recall that odd numbers end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9.
Find the first odd number after 5410: it is 5411.
Count forward by 2s until just below 5420: 5411, 5413, 5415, 5417, 5419.
Therefore, all five odd numbers between 5410 and 5420 are 5411, 5413, 5415, 5417, 5419.
